dialog.description: Builds every epic in scope in dependency waves, each one chained through the autonomous build → review → fix pipeline.
dialog.started: Night run started — wave 1/{waves}, {count, plural, one {# epic} other {# epics}}
dialog.startFailed: Failed to start the night run

conflicts.nightRunActive: A night run is already going for this project — wait for it to finish.
conflicts.batchActive: A batch build is still running — let it finish before starting the night.
conflicts.pipelineActiveOnEpic: A pipeline run is already active on an epic in this scope.

scope.label: Scope
scope.empty: No To Do epics to run
scope.emptyWithBacklog: No To Do or Backlog epics to run
scope.withPrerequisites: {count, plural, one {# epic} other {# epics}} + {prerequisites, plural, one {# required prerequisite} other {# required prerequisites}}
scope.note: Scope is every To Do epic. Prerequisites are pulled in automatically; epics already Done or Released are left alone.

options.failureStop: Stop — end the run after the wave
options.costCapHint: Claude-reported costs only — other CLIs are not counted, so the run may spend more than the cap.
options.circuitBreakerHint: Stop after this many consecutive epic failures (0 = off).

warning.unattended: Agents run unattended all night: they create worktrees and branches, commit code and spend API budget without anyone watching. Nothing gets approved or merged — every epic stops in Review for your sign-off in the morning.

summary.stopTitle: Stop launching new epics. Epics already running finish their pipeline.
summary.costCaveat: Some sessions reported no cost (only Claude Code returns one), so the total is a lower bound.
summary.stopRequested: Stopping — no new epic will be launched. The wave currently running is left to finish its pipelines.
summary.interrupted: Interrupted by a server restart — partial data. Sessions that were still running were marked orphaned at boot.
summary.noEpics: No epics were dispatched by this run.

abort.stopped: You stopped this run. Epics already running were left to finish; the rest were skipped.
abort.stoppedAtWave: You stopped this run (after wave {wave}). Epics already running were left to finish; the rest were skipped.
abort.other: Run stopped early: {reason}. Remaining epics were skipped.
abort.otherAtWave: Run stopped early: {reason} (after wave {wave}). Remaining epics were skipped.
